description: Call this tool to render one client's A4 statement of account and return a download link valid for one hour. Titled STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT, movements in date order, BALANCE OUTSTANDING at the foot. Pro.

as_of.description: Date printed on the statement, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today

client.description: Client id from the invoice server, an exact client name, or a name containing this text

currency.description: Only needed when the client has documents in more than one currency. Currencies are never added together

from.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-statement. Defaults to the client, currency and period; the statement comes back as a download link valid for one hour

to.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive

name: statement_pdf
title: Render the statement of account as a PDF
